title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Handoff Acceptance Boundary
goal: Define governed local acceptance boundaries for approval application authority grant handoff without enabling live acceptance, writes, execution, providers, dispatch, mutation, network, or spend.
safetyRules: Do not accept handoff, capture acceptance, hand off authority, grant authority, activate authority, apply approvals, write DB/runtime records, unlock execution, call providers/models, dispatch agents, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend unless a later subphase explicitly allows it.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, or raw policy dumps in primary UX.
Do not modify project, CareLoop, or generated project files.
Do not duplicate report writers, result envelopes, mode guards, redaction helpers, checker formatters, phase status updaters, route matrices, card components, or activity/evidence helpers.
commandCenterUx: P126.1 does not change Command Center UX. Later UX must stay scoped, read-only, theme-safe, and free of raw IDs/dumps/fake actions.
costImpact: No provider spend. Local checks/build/tests only.
